idea: EX3 V2 coupling mixture with the EX2-trained response prior
status: EXPLORATORY, frozen before any EX3 fit; separate from the frozen V2 comparison (DEV 1-2)
mechanism:
(from EX2 and the V2 design).  EX2 showed that a paid-only ML-II response prior removes most of J's
fast-scan depth over-prediction (NEW B40 specificity at 0.5: 0.104 -> 0.542).  The negatives that remain wrong at 0.5
are fast scans whose depth is above the 111 um reference, i.e. places where the depth-label bridge itself points the
wrong way.  V2 can move posterior mass away from rho = 1 when the paid labels contradict the bridge, but its coupling
is global: on NEW the paid positives (mostly deep slow scans) agree with the bridge, so the mass should stay near
rho = 1 and the mixture should behave like the fixed-coupling model
trained_part: f and g share k_f with EX2's paid-only ML-II amplitude and lengthscales for the same checkpoint (read from EX2 fit_log.csv; no refit); delta 0.35, theta 0.35, tau 0.15, sigma_z 0.03, rho prior 1/3 each unchanged

arms.rho1_trained_EP: the V2_trained rho=1 EP component (exact reuse; separate EP fit only after a whole-mixture fallback)
arms.J_trained: EX2 stored predictions (Laplace, rho = 1, same trained prior)
arms.Binary_V2_EP: new EP fits with the fixed reference prior, no continuous likelihood

predictions.EX3-P1_mechanism: NEW, B40: the median (over the 20 checkpoints) posterior mass of V2_trained on rho = 1 is >= 0.8. Falsified if it is below 0.8.
predictions.EX3-P2_consequence: NEW, B40, p >= 0.5: |BA(V2_trained) - BA(rho1_trained_EP)| < 0.01 (uncertain global coupling adds nothing once the response prior is trained). Falsified if the absolute difference is >= 0.01.
predictions.EX3-P3_inference: NEW, B40: rho1_trained_EP vs J_trained (EP vs Laplace with the same trained prior): no directional expectation; reported.
predictions.EX3-P4_reference: Binary_V2_EP (fixed prior, no depth) at 0.5 is reported as the depth-free reference; no expectation.

outcomes: BA, specificity, sensitivity, short-K sensitivity, q20, log loss, AUC at p >= 0.5; component masses; paired class-stratified simulation-cluster bootstrap

bounded_plan.runs: one; no tuning, all outcomes preserved
